model.name: Qwen3-4B
model.caveat: 4-bit lower bound excludes unquantized embeddings, quantization metadata, adapters, gradients, activations, optimizer and runtime memory.

proposal.quantization: 4-bit NF4 with nested quantization, frozen base weights
proposal.compute_dtype: float16 because this Turing GPU lacks native BF16
proposal.first_data: Only complete TRAIN examples whose measured full sequences fit; never truncate target JSON.
proposal.later_sequence_limit: Consider 1280 or 1536 only after measured memory headroom; full corpus max is below 1536.
proposal.attention: Start with standard attention supported by the installed stack; do not assume FlashAttention support.

documentation_findings: Current bitsandbytes documentation lists Python >=3.10, PyTorch >=2.4 and Windows CUDA 11.8-12.6 builds including sm75; compatibility still needs an actual future install/smoke test.
Official Transformers documentation recommends NF4 for training four-bit base models; only additional parameters are trained.
Official PEFT documentation describes preparing quantized models for adapter training.
Official TRL documentation supports conversational prompt/completion records and completion-only loss; its memory guide documents sequence-length and gradient-checkpointing tradeoffs.
next_gate_checks: Verify compatible wheel versions without altering the frozen base model
Measure forward/backward peak memory on a small TRAIN-only sample
Verify non-thinking chat template and completion-only labels
Stop on OOM or missing kernel; report observed results, not predicted duration
